entries.zh: 騙過了；把他騙過去了
entries.en: deceived him; fooled him (completive)

entries.zh: 被迷惑的；神魂顛倒的（如為情所惑）
entries.en: deceived, bewitched; dazzled (as by love)
entries.notes: L 栏 deamosroy 漫漶，疑为 de amores（为情所惑）之讹，释义据此推补。

entries.zh: 受某物所誘而受騙；因貪圖財物上當
entries.en: deceived by something; taken in by a thing/offer
entries.notes: H 栏原文〔疑:冏/哃〕字形不定，M「būe ìu」与 R「cuā iên」对音不合，四栏无法互证。

entries.zh: 騙鬼；欺瞞鬼神（以欺詐蒙騙神靈）
entries.en: to deceive the devil; to cheat or mock the spirits
entries.notes: L 栏 ador pte cien doe 残损难读（疑为 adorante de cien dioses），R 栏首音节 T99 污损，H 栏〔疑:鬼/咒〕。

entries.zh: 奸詐狡猾的人；騙子
entries.en: deceiver, liar; a cunning and treacherous person

entries.zh: 奸詐；行騙說謊之人
entries.en: deceitful, fraudulent; a swindler or liar

entries.zh: 欺騙；說謊
entries.en: to deceive; to lie
entries.notes: H 栏〔疑:那/邪〕首字待定，M、R 仅记音不能定字，词义靠 L 栏支撑。

entries.zh: 詭詐欺騙；以詭計行騙
entries.en: to deceive by cunning; to trick craftily
entries.notes: L 栏 mincientos 疑为 mintiendo（说谎）之讹；H 栏〔疑:誆/詎〕，M、R 音形小异。

entries.zh: 買賣中作假騙人；以包裹遮掩貨品行騙
entries.en: to cheat in a sale; to deceive a buyer by concealing the goods
entries.notes: H「包皮」本义为包裹外皮，买卖欺诈义由 L 栏 en la venta 定，属语境推补。

entries.zh: 強行欺騙；以威逼強索行騙
entries.en: to deceive by force; to coerce and cheat
entries.notes: H「要」取 iau 音，此处作胁迫索求解，与 L 栏 por fuerza 相合。

entries.zh: 欺騙並加害；坑害
entries.en: to deceive and harm; to cheat and injure

entries.zh: 設局行騙；騙局
entries.en: to set up a swindle; a fraud, a trap
entries.notes: L 栏 contracar 疑为 contracara 或 contra otro 之讹，H「騙局」与 M 音一致。

entries.zh: 拐騙婦孺；誘拐詐騙
entries.en: to swindle or abduct (children and women); to deceive by cajolery

entries.zh: 騙子；行徑卑劣的欺詐者
entries.en: a cheat; a deceiver of vile conduct
entries.notes: L 栏仅作 engañador，H「臭行」字面为恶行，释义由二者合成，属推补。

entries.zh: 說謊騙人者；以謊言行騙
entries.en: a liar and cheat; to deceive with lies

entries.zh: 以狡猾手段欺騙；設計誆騙
entries.en: to deceive cunningly; to trick by craft
entries.notes: H「暫注」字面为暂时标注，与 L 栏 con astucia 语义不合，疑原字为譖、諂一类，未能定夺。

entries.zh: 欺騙盲者與無知之人；蒙騙不識者
entries.en: to deceive the blind or inexperienced; to take advantage of the naive
entries.notes: L 栏 ciegas, infant 指向盲者与幼儿，H「青」取闽南语青盲（盲）之青，R 栏转写失真。

entries.zh: 兩面三刀；當面一套背後一套的欺騙
entries.en: two-faced; double-dealing, a "two-faced knife"

entries.zh: 兩頭蛇；兩面討好的騙子
entries.en: a two-headed snake; a double-dealer
entries.notes: R 栏 zpangrèn siè 漫漶不可读，H 与 M（siāng tāu choā）互证。

entries.zh: 如鱷魚般欲吞食眾人的騙子；坑害眾人者
entries.en: a deceiver who, like a caiman, wants to devour everyone
entries.notes: L 栏 caymang 即 caimán（鳄鱼）；H 栏〔疑:雞/食〕，M「jīng lâng」与 R「niō xīn: ngō xīn」互不相合，字与音均未定。

entries.zh: 以言語誤導（不論有無惡意）；失言致誤
entries.en: to mislead with words, with or without malice; to cause error by speech
entries.notes: L 栏 palabra y o sin malicia 中 y o 为残文，按「无论有无恶意」解。

entries.zh: 嚇騙；以恐嚇詐騙
entries.en: to cheat by intimidation; to bluff and swindle
entries.notes: L 栏 con jantste 残损不可读，释义依 H「嚇騙」及 M 异读 hēg piēn。

entries.zh: 哄騙；高聲喧嚷以哄人上當
entries.en: to deceive by shouting; to coax and cheat with loud words
entries.notes: L 栏 dando voces（大声叫喊）与 H「哄騙」的甜言哄诱义略有出入，取喧嚷哄骗之合解；句末 ate ndori car 为残文。
